OBSERVATION · The new symbol_specs are keyed by base_symbol(sym.upper()) so an EA sending both 'EURUSD' and 'EURUSD.i' would OVERWRITE the same key with whichever was last in the dict-iteration order. Rare (EAs typically send one symbol per base) but worth flagging if brokers ever expose duplicate suffix variants.
